rows.task_success_definition: 80-step lane keeping without exceeding |e|>.85m or |heading|>.30rad; does not require convergence to zero error
rows.limitation: Only trajectories whose visual residual stays inside the calibrated set directly satisfy this certificate premise. Safe empirical out-of-set trajectories are not retrospectively certified.
